scope: A0 / V-MIG-01..03; strict startup equality retained; development verification only

integrationOverlay.purpose: Verify legacy six -> baseline -> migration seven, including running-sequence refusal

environment.databaseIsolation: Every test creates and drops kapibala_test_<UUID>; baseline creates and drops kapibala_migration_reference_<UUID>

commands.command: DATABASE_URL=<isolated-test-server>/postgres npx tsx --test --test-name-pattern='migration|schema lag|PostgreSQL sessions' tests/integration/group-metadata.test.ts tests/integration/platform.test.ts tests/integration/auth.test.ts

observations.sameCountHistoryChange: Old integer schema refused by checksum, fresh database accepts changed text schema
observations.batchRollback: Version 2 SQL/ledger and version 3 DDL/data all rollback when version 3 ledger INSERT fails
observations.postCommitCleanupFailure: Changed reference DB owner during a gated baseline; DROP denied after target commit. Specialized error retained committed baseline evidence and exact reference name; test then removed reference and role explicitly.
observations.migration7Gate: Running sequence prevented SQL/ledger changes; completed-run fixture permitted migration; historical observation timestamp stayed NULL

readbackQueries: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname LIKE 'kapibala_test_%' OR datname LIKE 'kapibala_migration_reference_%'
SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'a0_%'

limits: Legacy baseline proves observed supported public catalog definitions match the pinned release; it cannot prove historical SQL bytes or business data correctness.
Operator must stop old service and exclude non-cooperative DDL during baseline; table and advisory locks do not block every possible new schema object.
Runtime startup validates files and ledger, not all physical schema definitions on every startup.
Target commit followed by cleanup failure is reported as committed; process kill or an unknown COMMIT outcome requires inspecting actual state.
No demonstration deployment, full-project regression suite, or owner acceptance was performed by this workstream.
